name: comp-461

frames.best_why: Shows the whole joined bar with all cells, page 3 shaded and the cursor away.

tagline: Page numbers joined into one segmented bar with arrow ends.
summary: A single pill-shaped pager whose cells hold a back chevron, pages 1 to 4, an ellipsis and a forward chevron, split by thin borders with the current page shaded.
appearance: One long rounded bar on black is divided into bordered cells: a left chevron, pages 1 to 4, a three-dot ellipsis and a right chevron, with only the outer ends rounded. The active page cell is filled a shade lighter than the rest.
behaviour: Hovering a cell fills it grey while the current page keeps its shading. The demo holds the page at 3, so the joined bar never changes width.
demo_content: Pages 1 to 4 with page 3 active and an ellipsis.
search_phrases: page numbers in a single pill
arrows at both ends of page list
row of page cells split by lines
use_when: A compact footer where the page controls should read as one unit, like a toolbar.
avoid_when: When the row must wrap on a phone: it is a single non-wrapping bar of cells.
customise: Pass currentPage, totalPages and the slot count; the joined outline cells, dividers and rounded outer ends are fixed classes.
weight_why: A single row of outlined cells; only hover fills and active shading.

a11y.note: Chevrons are labelled and focus is visible on cells; the hover fills have no reduced-motion handling.

issues: The ellipsis is drawn as an outlined cell but is not clickable, so it looks like a button.
polish_why: Crisp joined cells and even dividers; a genuinely different take on a pager.
